u0: Initial state: the ball is still blocking the cell in front of the locked door, and no key progress has been made. Objective: reach the ball and pick it up (or otherwise clear that cell) to achieve blocker_moved, earning reward and advancing. Avoid picking up the target box, which is a failure.
u1: The blocker has been moved, so the door cell is accessible. Objective: acquire the key matching the door's color to reach u2. If the target box is picked up here, it is a failure with -1. Do not drop the ball back in front of the door, which would undo blocker_moved.
u2: The agent holds the matching door key and the blocker is still moved. Objective: toggle the door open to reach the final state u3 (+0.5). Do not drop the key while the door is closed (key_lost, -0.1 back to u1), and do not put the ball back in front of the door (-0.2 back to u0). Picking up the target box is a -1 failure.
u3: Goal state: the door is open and the agent holds the matching key. Objective: keep the door open and avoid picking up the target box (which would end in failure u4). If the door is toggled shut, return to u2 (-0.3). Do not let progress regress; this is the terminal success state of the machine.
u4: Failure sink: the target box was picked up, which the task forbids. All transitions loop here with no reward. The episode is effectively lost; no recovery is defined.
